verdict.rationale: Angular's official docs claim fine-grained reactivity via Signals, directly matching the story's core claim of dependents-only re-execution, but the evidence pack lacks independent/hands-on confirmation of signal-level granularity, and older community feedback describes the legacy digest/dirty-checking model which re-checks broadly rather than fine-grained updates. missing for 10: independent benchmarks or hands-on validation of Signals' fine-grained dependency tracking, clarification on how this coexists with zone.js/change detection for non-signal code.
